description: This PHP class 'printDocOptions' manages options and preferences related to document and test settings for the TestLink project. It provides methods to retrieve configuration options for documentation, test specifications, requirement specifications, and execution options, as well as aggregated variables and JavaScript-ready preference strings.

classes.name: printDocOptions
classes.description: A class encapsulating various document and test option configurations for TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the option arrays for documentation, test specifications, requirement specifications, and execution options.

methods.name: getDocOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of document format options.

methods.name: getTestSpecOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of test specification options.

methods.name: getReqSpecOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of requirement specification options.

methods.name: getExecOpt
methods.description: Returns the array of execution options.

methods.name: getAllOptVars
methods.description: Returns an associative array of all option variables with checked states normalized to 0 or 1.

methods.name: getJSPrintPreferences
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of all option 'value's suitable for JavaScript use.
